reason: A well-known growth form (tree euphorbias, aloes) with no PATO term; branched alone loses the shape of the branching.

label: umbilicate

reason: Umbilicate is a standard glossary term with no PATO term. Low confidence because here the quality sits on the fruit's apical pore, a part that has no class.
